text: [208] pañcime bhikkhave ādīnavā dantakaṭṭhassa akhādane katame pañca acakkhussaṃ mukhaṃ duggandhaṃ hoti rasaharaṇiyo na visujjhanti pittaṃ semhaṃ bhattaṃ pariyonaddhati 2 bhattamassa nacchādeti ime kho bhikkhave pañca ādīnavā dantakaṭṭhassa akhādane . pañcime bhikkhave ānisaṃsā dantakaṭṭhassa khādane katame pañca cakkhussaṃ #1 yu. khudaṃ . 2 yu. pariyonaddhanti . mukhaṃ na duggandhaṃ hoti rasaharaṇiyo visujjhanti pittaṃ semhaṃ bhattaṃ na pariyonaddhati bhattamassa chādeti ime kho bhikkhave pañca ānisaṃsā dantakaṭṭhassa khādaneti .
